title: Client Alert: D-3 Deliverable Risk — UAS-11 Data Integrity

fields.subject: UAS-11 – Data Integrity Concern – D-3
fields.body:
SPO,

The Payload Operator has reported a 150-meter uncommanded position jump in UAS-11 telemetry, followed by loss of RTK-1 and aircraft GNSS fix under clear sky conditions. Data collection over the meadow occurred between 09:12 and 09:18.

Given the timing and nature of the anomaly, we are concerned that the multispectral and hyperspectral data from this window may be corrupted or compromised.

Please confirm whether the data collected between 09:12 and 09:18 is usable for Deliverable D-3 (calibrated hyperspectral cubes from the Lakeshore Flight Area summer campaign). The CP&L task order requires D-3 by November 15, 2026, with a 10-day cure period.

Do not initiate any data transfer to CP&L until this is resolved.

— CP&L Program Office

CP&L Program Office

instructorNote: This inject pressures the SPO to act on the threat of a late deliverable. Watch for confirmation that the General Manager has been notified and that data transfer has been halted.
